what: Fidelity National Financial is America's largest title insurer: when a house is sold, it checks who legally owns it and insures the buyer and lender against a defect in that ownership. It also owns the annuity business F&G.
customers: Home buyers, mortgage lenders and estate agents at closing, plus annuity buyers through F&G.
money: title insurance policies and escrow services on property transactions
fixed indexed annuities and pension risk transfer
moat: Title plants: proprietary records of every property transfer in a county, assembled over decades, which a new entrant cannot recreate.
risks: Title revenue depends on how many houses change hands, which collapses when mortgage rates rise
Only four analysts cover the stock
opportunities: 11 times earnings and 3.9 times EBITDA with $5.5B of free cash flow
F&G grows annuity assets steadily and is worth a substantial part of the market value on its own
watch: Title order counts, which lead revenue, and F&G's annuity sales.
